Dashed: logical IDs; multiplicity is not an integrity guarantee.<br>Friendship pair UNIQUE(userOneId,userTwoId); UserBlock PK(blockerId,blockedUserId); UserRole UNIQUE(userId,roleId).<br>Cross-service user references and refresh replacement IDs are not database foreign keys. Multiplicity describes each named role; two-role links do not mean one shared user.<br>Dashed-link multiplicities are intended or possible associations; a stored ID does not guarantee the target exists." vertex="1" parent="1" style="text;html=1;whiteSpace=wrap;overflow=hidden;fontFamily=Arial;fontSize=13;align=left;verticalAlign=top;fontColor=#687782;fontFamily=Arial;"><mxGeometry as="geometry" x="35" y="965.0079999999998" width="2844.016" height="135"/></mxCell></root></mxGraphModel></diagram></mxfile>

div.div:
Solid entity links: declared PG FK / Mongo ORM. Dashed: logical IDs; multiplicity is not an integrity guarantee.
Friendship pair UNIQUE(userOneId,userTwoId); UserBlock PK(blockerId,blockedUserId); UserRole UNIQUE(userId,roleId).
Cross-service user references and refresh replacement IDs are not database foreign keys. Multiplicity describes each named role; two-role links do not mean one shared user.
Dashed-link multiplicities are intended or possible associations; a stored ID does not guarantee the target exists.
